brief: No new setups: 5 of 5 slots are open (LINK, BTC, CRV, DOGE, SOL) and none has a broken premise; all five rest on structure, not on HL funding, so L2 does not apply. Delta: XPL short was cancelled on a funding reset (+0.47R) and AAVE and UNI shorts were stopped. PONS is the only local-crowding outlier (funding 64.69, 40.23 over CEX). hl-cycles data is stale (16.9 h), so the regime read is a gap. NFP on 2026-11-06 is the next catalyst.
